[p. 1]
Example paper — made up for testing ScholarPath. It is not a real study.

Abstract. This imaginary study followed twenty secondary-school students who used an AI writing assistant for four weeks. We analysed their drafts and interviewed each student.

[p. 2]
Method. Participants were recruited through a convenience sample at one school. Twenty students took part. Data came from drafts and semi-structured interviews.

[p. 3]
Results. Students accepted most grammar suggestions but ignored most suggestions about structure and argument.
